[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Vegan chili: Combine kidney beans, black beans, diced tomatoes, onion, garlic, chili powder, cumin, and vegetable broth in a slow cooker.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Grilled vegetables: Toss sliced zucchini, bell peppers, mushrooms, and onions with olive oil and balsamic vinegar, grill until tender.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Broccoli and cashew stir-fry: Sauté broccoli, bell peppers, and cashews with garlic, soy sauce, and ginger; serve over brown rice or quinoa.
